FOV_stratification_future_reporting.empty_or_degenerate_strata: Report support and undefined metrics explicitly; never omit difficult bins or equate low support with equivalence.
FOV_stratification_future_reporting.extent_basis: Primary frozen source512-pixel extent proxy, plus separately labelled actual224-pixel A and16-pixel B extent proxies. Also report angular extent and its source definition; no repair of unknown/reversed/half-light values.
reports: object count and class support per stratum

metadata_only_future_control.model: Fixed multinomial logistic regression, C=1, balanced class weights,max_iter=1000,lbfgs,no grid search. Nonconvergence is reported, not silently tuned. A depth3 decision tree is a separately reported fixed diagnostic, random_state=active_split_seed, no outcome-driven tuning.
metadata_only_future_control.preprocessing: Train-only median imputation for missing logextent; explicit missingness indicator; train-only centering/scaling on unique objects. No held-out fitting.
metadata_only_future_control.purpose: Measure available class information without pixels; association is not a causal leakage proof.
